summary: REQ-10 branding rename to “Meyouu” appears implemented in key user-facing locations shown in the diff: browser tab title, header logo alt text, footer copyright line, and browse/home hero alt text + main heading. Cannot fully verify the “no remaining user-facing ‘Marketplace’” condition beyond the files shown, though asset filenames still include “marketplace-*” (not necessarily user-facing copy).
